primary_references.title: EN 18286:2026 Annex ZA (Table ZA.1): which AI Act requirements the presumption covers
primary_references.url_status: CEN-CENELEC notice (2026-10-15) read; it does not reproduce Annex ZA.
primary_references.label: REPORTED
primary_references.basis: Secondary page reproducing Table ZA.1 (19 rows; not compared with the standard text): Annex ZA is informative and says conformity with the Table ZA.1 clauses gives a presumption only within the scope of the standard and only from Official Journal citation. Covered: Article 11(1) first sentence (on condition the technical documentation holds all Annex IV items); Article 17(1) first sentence and the first part of the second sentence; Article 17(1)(a) to (m) (point (g) on condition the risk management system complies with Article 9). Not covered: Article 17(2), 17(3), 17(4). No Table ZA.1 row for Articles 9, 72 or 73 as such (reached only through 17(1)(g), (h), (i)). 11 clauses have no row. Row remark: applying the standard does not as such ensure all regulatory requirements are met. WARNING 1: the presumption lasts only while the Official Journal keeps the reference.
to_verify: Compare each Table ZA.1 row and condition with the purchased standard
Check the 11 clauses with no row
primary_references.required_action: Confirm against the standard text once EN 18286:2026 is bought (EVS listing: English PDF, 32.24 EUR incl. tax).

update_protocol: Re-check each primary reference and watch item at the agreed cadence.
Record the check date and what was actually opened. If a primary source could not be opened, say so and leave the label at REPORTED.
Never promote a label to VERIFIED without reading the primary text.
Do not change public site copy (data.json, legislation.html, aegis-guard.html) without an owner decision.
